info.title: Automation Bridge
info.description:
Automation Bridge protocol v1 (protocol/automation-bridge-v1.md). Every request except /healthz is HMAC-signed: X-Bridge-Key-Id, X-Bridge-Timestamp, X-Bridge-Nonce, X-Bridge-Signature = hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, METHOD
PATH_WITH_QUERY
TIMESTAMP
NONCE
hex(sha256(body))).
